title: How is a dormant Savings & Money Market Accounts account reactivated after the owner's transfer in the same contact?
content:
## Situation and policy

A dormant Savings & Money Market Accounts account is reactivated when its identity-verified owner makes a customer-initiated transaction in the same contact, and that transaction's posted date becomes the account's new date of latest customer-initiated activity.

- **What this policy covers.** Reactivation through a transfer out that the owner makes in the contact by telephone, online or mobile banking to one of their own checking accounts. Reactivation through any other customer-initiated transaction is outside this policy.
- **Made in this contact.** That the transfer was made in this contact is established from the contact itself, where the owner makes it, not from the ledger. It is a condition for reactivation under this policy, and the reactivation date worked out from the records does not test it.

## Business effect

One call sets the account's status to active and records the given date as the date of the account's latest customer-initiated activity, the date from which inactivity is counted again. The account lookup then shows status active and the new activity date.

## How it is invoked

The tool is reactivate_savings_account_bfe70db1. It is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| savings_account_id | the reference number of the dormant savings or money market account, as returned by the savings account lookup | identifier |
| customer_id | the customer reference number of the account owner whose identity was verified in this conversation, as returned by the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| reactivation_date | the posted date of the customer-initiated transaction that reactivates the account | YYYY-MM-DD |

The tool records the values it is given; it does not look for the transaction, work out the date or check the owner's identity itself.

## Return

A successful call returns savings_account_id (the account reactivated), customer_id (the owner), status (always active) and last_customer_activity_date (YYYY-MM-DD, the date recorded). A status of active means the reactivation was recorded.

## Contract Q&A

**What does the call change on the account?** Its status, to active, and its latest customer-initiated activity date, to the date given. Nothing else is changed.
